comments.text: Jump Pad: Make Jump Pad puts a trigger volume (named jumppad) at an entity; wire Begin Overlap (name jumppad) into Launch From Jump Pad. Bots that walk on it fly too.
Launch From Jump Pad: Who is Begin Overlap's who (only players fly); Speed 0 is 800 units a second straight up.

Double Jump: Wire Player Pressed Button (Jump) in with the player. On the ground it only notes the jump; in the air it boosts once. Bots: Bot Wants Ability can fire it now and then while they chase or flee (call it from a Repeat for bots in the air).

Dash: Wire Player Pressed Button (Reload, or any key you like) in with the player. Not ready says the seconds left. Bots: from a Repeat, Bot Wants Ability (Ability with Cooldown) lets them dash now and then while chasing or fleeing; the cooldown holds for them too.
Teleporter Pair: Wire a pad's Begin Overlap (or Player Touched) in with the other pad's entity as To. The cooldown stops a player bouncing straight back. Bots use teleporters they walk into.

Ability with Cooldown: Wire your key or event into In with the Player; build the ability on Use. Cooldown 0 is 10 seconds. Bots: Bot Wants Ability (Chance a second, 0: 25%) says yes when a living enemy is within Range (0: 1500) so a Repeat every second can fire it in fights.
Ability with Cooldown: each player has their own cooldown. Seconds left is whole seconds (for a HUD line).
Fireball: Wire it after Ability with Cooldown's Use. The explosion hurts in a radius and the kills go to the thrower. Bots can throw it through Bot Wants Ability.
Fireball: the projectile carries the damage (Radius 150, an explosion where it hits); the kills go to the thrower.

Proximity Mine: Place Mine makes a trigger volume named mine and a marker. Wire Begin Overlap (name mine) into Mine Stepped On. Its owner can't set it off. How many a player may lay is up to your mode. Bots: the mine is marked for bots to avoid once Bots Avoid Area exists (until then they may walk into it).

Health Pack: Spawn Health Pack at an entity (Spawn Health Pack Here takes a position); wire Begin Overlap (name heal) into Take Health Pack. A full-health player leaves it. Bots: each pack is a loot goal, so hurt or not, bots go and grab it.
Take Health Pack: Volume and Who are Begin Overlap's (name heal). Respawn after 0 is 20 seconds. How many pickups a map has is up to you.

Weapon Pickup: Spawn Weapon Pickup at an entity (Spawn Weapon Pickup Here takes a position); wire Begin Overlap (name weap) into Take Weapon Pickup with the Weapon name (ak47, awp, m4a1...). Bots: each spawner is a loot goal, so bots go and grab it.
Take Weapon Pickup: Volume and Who are Begin Overlap's (name weap). Respawn after 0 is 20 seconds. How many pickups a map has is up to you.
Countdown HUD: Wire Round Started (or Freeze Time Ended) in. Label goes before the time (empty: Time left); it stops at 0 and runs Done. Bots don't read it.

Hot Potato: Give Potato to start (a random player); wire Player Hurt into Pass Potato (Attacker, Victim). Bots: everyone else hunts the holder, and the holder runs (a bot holder follows the farthest player away for a few seconds).
Potato Tick: call it every second (a Repeat from Round Started). Blew up is Yes on the tick it went off; give a new potato then.
